items.title: Rahul Gandhi tells INDIA-bloc leaders to be 'ready to mobilise' within 24 hours; mock Parliament session with symbolic 'impeach the CEC' move proposed for early-November Ramlila Maidan rally
items.summary: During the Oct 13 high-tea meeting at his residence (sources cited by World News 24x7; The Indian Express via Inshorts), Rahul Gandhi advised opposition parties and outfits to remain 'ready to mobilise' against the government within 24 hours if required. Attendees agreed to fix the next course of action after the Supreme Court hears the INDIA bloc's SIR petition. A proposal was also discussed to hold a mock Parliament session during a joint Opposition rally planned for the first week of November at Delhi's Ramlila Maidan, featuring a symbolic move to 'impeach' CEC Gyanesh Kumar - the idea is to be discussed further before any final decision.
